question: Should OpenClaw change the Discord component callback fallback from 30 minutes to 7 days and raise the override ceiling from 24 hours to 30 days for existing deployments?
rationale: The code review can verify the bounds and authorization path, but the default/cap change intentionally alters upgrade behavior and stale-action exposure for Discord operators.

options.title: Preserve opt-in async TTL
options.body: Keep the 30-minute default and solve long review flows through explicit agentComponents.ttlMs configuration or a smaller cap until maintainers sponsor a broader default change.

options.title: Accept the 7-day default
options.body: Approve the PR's 7-day fallback and 30-day maximum as the desired Discord product/security tradeoff after branch and docs repair.

options.title: Choose a narrower lifetime
options.body: Revise the PR to a middle-ground default or maximum, such as preserving the default while raising only the explicit override ceiling.

recommendation.title: Preserve opt-in async TTL
recommendation.body: Keep the 30-minute default and solve long review flows through explicit agentComponents.ttlMs configuration or a smaller cap until maintainers sponsor a broader default change.
